import sys, os, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/data/scripts')
import spotter_campaign_acl as acl

# Campaign visibility is enforced HERE, not in the browser. The registry is one
# global node (:SpotterMeta {key:'campaigns'}) and this webhook is the only read
# path the UI has, so filtering here is what makes a campaign private.
# Ownership rules live in scripts/spotter_campaign_acl.py (shared with WF16/18).
try:
    user = acl.caller(_items)
    if not user:
        # No X-Spotter-User means the request did not arrive through the
        # authenticating nginx proxy. Fail closed rather than leaking the list.
        return [{'json': {'campaigns': [], 'error': 'unauthenticated'}}]

    camps = acl.read_campaigns()
    return [{'json': {
        'campaigns': acl.visible(camps, user),
        'user': user,
        'quota': acl.quota_state(camps, user),
    }}]
except Exception as e:
    return [{'json': {'campaigns': [], 'error': str(e)[:400]}}]

meta.notes: POST /webhook/list-campaigns {} - Returns the SHARED campaign registry so every operator hitting the same SPOTTER backend sees the same campaigns. Reads the single global Neo4j node (:SpotterMeta {key:'campaigns'}). Returns {campaigns:[...]} (empty list if unset). Paired with save-campaigns (WF18).
